mapper.select: SELECT task.id AS task_id, task.task_no, meter.id AS meter_id, meter.meter_no, meter.meter_name, meter.meter_type, meter.display_type, meter.unit, task.executor_type, CASE task.executor_type WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN task.meter_reader_id WHEN 'DEVICE' THEN task.device_id END AS executor_id, CASE task.executor_type WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN reader.username WHEN 'DEVICE' THEN device.device_no END AS executor_code, CASE task.executor_type WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN reader.display_name WHEN 'DEVICE' THEN device.device_name END AS executor_name, task.task_status, task.scheduled_at, task.started_at, task.submitted_at, task.completed_at, task.cancelled_at, task.failed_reason, task.cancel_reason, task.retry_count, task.version, task.remark, task.created_by, task.updated_by, task.created_at, task.updated_at FROM meter_reading_task AS task INNER JOIN meter ON meter.id = task.meter_id LEFT JOIN sys_user AS reader ON reader.id = task.meter_reader_id AND task.executor_type = 'METER_READER' LEFT JOIN device ON device.id = task.device_id AND task.executor_type = 'DEVICE' WHERE task.id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM meter_reading_task WHERE id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
